title: Lantern Lake Fishing [left in English, not translated]
hud.cast: Throw [verbal noun 'throwing'; generic 'throw', the casting sense comes only from context]
hud.reel: Pull [verbal noun 'pulling'; generic 'pull/draw', the reeling-in sense comes only from context]
fish.lantern_eel: Lamp eel [literally 'lamp eel'; 'шам' means lamp or candle; bare noun-noun compound reads slightly unusual]
shop.rods: Fishing rods [the word 'қармақ' can mean either fishing hook or fishing rod]
shop.buy_robux: Buy for {price} Robux [mixes scripts: Latin 'Robux' with a Cyrillic case suffix '-қа'; 'алу' is literally 'get/take', read as 'buy' here]
pass.lucky_bait: Lucky bait doubles the chance of catching rare fish!
sell.prompt: Press E to sell [mixes scripts: Latin key letter 'E' with a Cyrillic suffix '-ні']
ascend.confirm: Ascend now? You will start over from the beginning, but you will catch rare fish {bonus}% more often.
weather.storm: A storm is coming! Rare fish are biting the bait! [says the storm is approaching, not that it is already here]
quest.title: Tasks
quest.catch_n: Catch {n} fish in Moonlit Bay [place name translated as 'Айлы шығанақ', literally 'moonlit bay'; only the first word is capitalized, so it could read as a generic 'a moonlit bay']
quest.claim: Get [generic 'take/get'; the same verb is used for 'buy' in the shop]
friends.boost: Fishing together with friends gives +{percent}% luck
codes.redeemed: Code accepted! Enjoy your reward! [second sentence is the traditional congratulation formula, literally 'may your gift be blessed']
afk.kicked: You stood still for too long, so fishing stopped.
daily.streak: Day {day} in a row! Come back tomorrow to get another reward.
tip.night: Tip: some fish only bite at night.
group.join: Join our group and get 50 free bait!
